name: morningstar
description: Morningstar fund research plugin for screening, summarizing, and comparing funds and ETFs using Morningstar MCP data.

interface.shortDescription: Screen, summarize, and compare funds with Morningstar MCP data.
interface.longDescription: Bundled Morningstar fund workflows for Codex: production screening with normalization, fund returns screening, single-fund deep summaries, and side-by-side comparison for 2 to 4 funds. Outputs are constrained to Morningstar MCP tool results and include explicit data-availability disclosures.
defaultPrompt: Use fund-screener to find Gold-rated US large-cap ETFs.
Use fund-comparison to compare VFIAX, SWPPX, and FXAIX.
